answer: The grove counter is kept in onyx and velvet shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4876 identities would post 3371 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
